CHECK BURST K1p-paintchk-walk-E — invert the advanced paint-over sheet into registered frames, build the GEAR LAYER inside declared regions only, and measure what the generator changed elsewhere (Run C-3 P5 fork C / Q75 primitive). REPORT ONLY. task_id "K1p-paintchk-walk-E".

Inputs (read-only): base sheet /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P5-sheets/sheet_walk_E.png and its composition record /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/P5-sheets/sheet_walk_E.json (union_crop_512, cells[paste,size], scale — the inverse is stated in its 'inverse' field); edited sheet /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/K1p-paint-walk-E/sheet_walk_E_advanced.png (same 1024×1536 layout); base frames = the json's source_dir (512×512 RGBA walk_E_NN.png). Frozen tools under /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/ (run, never modify): gates/matte.py (extract, alpha_floor=40, edge_mode='clamp'), gates/mask_composite.py (composite, evaluate = G12), gates/silhouette64.py (distance), oracle/video_cut.py (track → tip_xy, head_top_y, H, bbox). python glue importing these is fine; no new tool files.

For each frame k: (1) crop cell k of the EDITED sheet at [paste, paste+size], matte it on the plate (extract, clamp), resize with LANCZOS to the union_crop size and place it at union_crop (x0,y0) on a 512 transparent canvas = variant_k (the base frame is the untouched source frame k). (2) Regions on the BASE frame: STAFF HEAD box = a square of side 0.22·H centred on the staff tip (tip_xy from video_cut.track on the base alpha; if tip_xy is null use the topmost alpha≥128 point outside the head box) shifted up by 0.06·H; PAULDRON box = the FAR shoulder in right profile: x from torso_cx − 0.16·H to torso_cx + 0.12·H (torso_cx = mean x of alpha≥128 pixels in the band head_top+0.20·H … head_top+0.45·H), y from head_top + 0.10·H to head_top + 0.32·H. (3) out_k, mask_k, metrics = mask_composite.composite(base_k, variant_k, region_box, thresh=24, dilate_px=3) applied once per region (staff head then pauldron, the second on the first's output); G12 = mask_composite.evaluate(base_k, out_k, union mask). (4) Report per frame: mask area fraction per region, G12 value, silhouette64 distance(base_k alpha, variant_k alpha), and OUTSIDE-REGIONS drift = mean |RGB| (alpha-union weighted) between base_k and variant_k with both region boxes excluded — this number says how much the edit changed the body the gear should not touch. Write the composited advanced frames to out/advanced/frames/walk/E/walk_E_NN.png (512 RGBA, same names as the base), out/advanced/registration.json (copy the base cut's fps_out: 12 and the region rules), out/checks.json (per-frame table + means + maxima; every passed = null), out/regions_overlay.png (4 frames: base with both boxes drawn | variant | out), out/gear_layer_strip.png (the pixels that came from the variant only, on #3a3f4a).
No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 12 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K1p-paintchk-walk-E"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything not computed. Never PASS/FAIL.
